skills.name: Full Of Lies
skills.description: Poses on an offering box, giving good effects to allies.  *HP x 60% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec) *Reflects 80% of incoming skill damage as physical damage (10 sec) *Reflects 80% of incoming skill damage as magic damage (10 sec)

skills.name: Orochi Calling
skills.description: Summons snakes, inflicting bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3500% Area Damage  *Enemy Hit Rate -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Attack Range -40% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Story
abilities.description: Put Monogatari Series Tie-Up Rangers into a Team to get HP buffs in battle. You must have a Team that has at least 2 Rangers from the same group in order to get group buffs. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
